values.note: Campground closes in the winter; reservations are taken only for April 15 - October 31. Outside those dates call the office to check whether it is open, and every site is first come.

season.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Lee/Park/Pollmiller-Park/Facility/Pollmiller-Campsite-14-Reservable ('Pollmiller campground closes in the winter. Reservations are only taken for dates between April 15th and October 31st ... During the off-season, all sites will be available on a first come, first served basis.'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Half the sites reservable online (the county says 'up to five days in advance'), the other half walk-up, registered and paid at the campground kiosk. Reservations are final and non-refundable.

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Lee/Park/Pollmiller-Park/Facility/Pollmiller-Campsite-14-Reservable ('LCCB requires a two night minimum stay on weekends and a three night minimum stay on certain holiday weekends'; 'All reservations ... are final and non-refundable') + Camping page + site 01 ('register and pay for the site at the kiosk'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: Lee County: walk-up sites $25, reservable sites $26 online plus a $4 processing fee per reservation. Read 2026-11-03.

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Lee/Park/Pollmiller-Park/Facility/Pollmiller-Campsite-14-Reservable ('Reservable campsites are $26.00 per night when booked online ... a $4.00 processing fee') + site 01 ('The fee for this site is $25.00 per night'), read 2026-11-03

note: Lee County Conservation's 86-acre park east of West Point, with the campground on a wooded peninsula in a small lake; trails, playground, and a sandy swim beach with a concession stand (Memorial Day - Labor Day, Wednesday - Sunday). Youth camp area by arrangement with the ranger. --Claude
summary: Hookups 50/W/S confirmed; sites 30 added; showers confirmed, flush toilets added; season Apr 15-Oct 31 added; booking filled (half reservable, 2/3-night weekend/holiday minimums); fees $25-26 + $4 confirmed. Waterfront lead lakeview -> not waterfront. Dump station not on the county pages.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakeview -> not waterfront (unsure after every source, downgraded): the lake measures ~16 acres (~6.5 ha, from a traced outline on the 600 m frame), so it is a lake, not a pond. The campground fills a peninsula in it, but every pad is set back ~25-50 m behind a continuous tree belt on the north and east shores (110 m frame, summer leaf-on), with no open land to the water. The county's site photos (site 14 page) show pads, tables and woods, no water; the campground map is a stylised brochure graphic (forbidden as sole basis). Candidates if a photo ever shows a filtered view: sites 6, 8, 9 and 10 on the east/north edge.
DUMP: the stored dump=true (derived from the old note) is not on any county page I read, nor on the campground map; left.
BOOKING WINDOW: the county's 'Half of the sites are reservable up to five days in advance' is ambiguous (a cutoff or the opening?), so no reserve_until written; in the booking note only.
SITE 01 is about 52 x 22 ft; site 14 about 58 x 30 ft. Both fit a 23-ft rig.
